newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE Dec Bund futures set new contract high.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE Dec Bund futures set new contract high.

text.p: December Bund futures traded on LIFFE set a new contract high above 100.02 on Tuesday, charting a new record at 100.07 by 1547 GMT.

Traders said news that Russian President Boris Yeltsin's heart operation had been successfully completed was boosting debt prices, particularly Bunds. A chirpy U.S. Treasuries market was also lending support, they said.
The previous December Bund contract record was at 100.02, set on November 1.
